recipe.visualDefinition: A group of five men standing in a horizontal row on a rocky coastline, with crashing ocean waves in the background. The image features a high-grain, slightly faded 1960s film aesthetic with a cool blue sky and warm, earthy tones in the foreground rocks and clothing.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject row against a horizon line
Rough rock texture versus soft water spray
Cool blue sky contrasting with warm skin tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Mid-ground, full-body to knee-up figures spanning the width of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the white shirt provides a bright focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Left-to-right scan across the faces, then downward to the textured rocks, then upward to the horizon.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Upper third of the frame occupied by sky and sea spray.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blue and white (sky and sea)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark browns and blacks (trousers and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm ochre and tan (rocks and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a slightly lifted black point, creating a hazy, sun-bleached look.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single weight sans-serif paired with a small, dense logo block in the bottom corner.
graphicDevices: Small circular logo emblem in bottom left

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary minimalist, airy feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-grain 1960s color photograph of five men in vintage casual attire standing on a rocky shore with crashing ocean waves behind them. Muted, sun-bleached color palette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add thin, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top left corner with wide tracking. Add a small circular and rectangular logo block in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture visible across the entire image?
Is the text in the top left corner thin and unobtrusive?
Are the colors muted and vintage-inspired?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the lineup
Level of ocean spray in the background

mustAchieve: Natural, unposed feel to the group

postGenerationChecks: Check for five distinct figures without anatomical errors
Ensure the text does not obscure the faces
Verify the color palette remains within the muted blue/brown range
Confirm the grain doesn't look like digital noise
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Film Portrait + Rocky Coastline + Geometric Sans-Serif Header + Muted Analog Palette
